prompt:
TASK: Edit image 1. This is a local revision of the supplied artwork.
INPUT IMAGES (in supplied order):
Image 1: edit-target. Base image to edit; requested changes take precedence over preservation.
CHANGE REQUEST:
Reframe as a closer tall medium shot: Meera from about the knees up, about 1.6 times larger than now, standing at the right-centre, with the top third of the image left as plain, empty light wall for a speech balloon. Put her in the same evening office as the neighbouring panels: a wooden desk edge with the open silver laptop (blank abstract form) beside her, a warm evening window with a roller blind, a plant; no other people (Dr. Ananya is off-panel to the left). Keep Meera's identity (large round eyes, high thin brows, round face, braid over her left shoulder, blue block-print kurta, white churidar, silver bangle on her right wrist), her bright smile looking up from the phone, the staff phone held in her right hand at upper-chest height with its abstract calendar screen toward the reader, and her left hand relaxed at her side. Remove the small dark dot on her cheek; no moles. No text.
PRESERVE: retain all areas, identity traits, acting, clothing, composition and lettering space outside the requested change. The change request overrides preservation where necessary; repair connected anatomy, contact objects and occlusion together. Supporting images supply only their stated roles. Do not copy their entire scene or pose.
OUTPUT: one edited image matching the target aspect. Do not add text, guide marks or a global style filter. Re-measure faces and mouths and inspect lettering space after adoption.
